tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on it; `color-text` reads 14.9:1 here.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Filled surfaces: cards, inputs, dialogs. `color-text` reads 13.7:1 here.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Ink for all body copy and headings on `color-bg` and `color-surface`.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: primary button fill, links, focus ring, kickers, the selected segment. 3.8:1 on `color-bg` — fine for icons, large text and chrome, NOT for body-size text (use `color-accent-700`). The source pairs `color-bg` text on this fill in the primary button (3.8:1 at 13px/800): kept exact, below 4.5:1.

tokens.name: color-accent-2
tokens.usage: Machine-derived stand-in for a second accent (mono scheme). Treat as the same role as `color-accent`; don't introduce it as a new voice.

tokens.name: color-divider
tokens.usage: Rules and control borders: 2px section rules (`.hr`, nav, table head), 1px input/segment borders and row rules. Source value is `color-mix(in srgb, #201e1d 40%, transparent)`. ≈2.4:1 on `color-bg` — below 3:1 for control borders; kept exact from the source.
